data.body: **[P2] Propagate fatal MDC restoration failures to the invocation caller.** If asynchronous `restore.close()` throws `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath`, this still completes `result` with the previously selected outcome, so Lambda may return success or `PENDING` while the fatal escapes only the worker. Complete `result` exceptionally with the fatal—preserving suppression and fatal precedence—before rethrowing it, and update the asynchronous restoration test to assert the caller observes the same fatal.
